correctness.rationale: For arbitrary measurable binary responses, deterministic reduction and pointwise optimization give the \(L^1\)-norm of an odd hemisphere transform. The transform is \(2/\pi\)-Lipschitz. Lévy spherical isoperimetry gives the exact superlevel bound for every odd \(L\)-Lipschitz function on \(\mathbb S^2\), and layer-cake integration yields bias at most \(1-2/\pi\). A hemispherical response attains equality. The singlet value \(3/4\) follows from the exact uniform law of the dot product of two independent uniform directions.
